# Crossfade & luma wipe

Blends to the next image everywhere at once, through noise, or along a luma pattern (linear, radial, diamond or spiral) with a soft edge that can glow in the theme accent. A luma texture of your own drives the wipe when set.

<EffectDemo effect="crossfade" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { crossfade } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/crossfade';

const effect = crossfade({ preset: 'dissolve' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.pattern = 'noise'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                                               | Default   | Range        | Description                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `pattern`  | 'fade' \| 'noise' \| 'linear' \| 'radial' \| 'diamond' \| 'spiral' | `'noise'` |              | Order in which pixels change: all at once, in noisy patches, or along a shape.                                                                   |
| `softness` | number                                                             | `0.15`    | 0.001 – 1    | Width of the blend edge, as a fraction of the wipe.                                                                                              |
| `angle`    | number                                                             | `0`       | -180 – 180 ° | Linear: direction the wipe travels.                                                                                                              |
| `scale`    | number                                                             | `4`       | 0.5 – 32     | Noise: size of the patches (higher is finer). Spiral: number of turns.                                                                           |
| `invert`   | boolean                                                            | `false`   |              | Run the pattern backwards, for example radial from the edges in.                                                                                 |
| `edgeGlow` | number                                                             | `0`       | 0 – 4        | Accent color added along the moving edge. Above about 0.6, a glow sweeping across the screen within a second can count as flashing (WCAG 2.3.1). |
| `luma`     | 2D texture                                                         | `null`    |              | A grayscale image whose dark areas change first; overrides the pattern when set.                                                                 |
| `seed`     | integer                                                            | `0`       | 0 – 9999     | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames.                                                                          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                              |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `dissolve` | `pattern: 'noise'`, `softness: 0.08`, `scale: 8`      |
| `iris`     | `pattern: 'radial'`, `softness: 0.1`, `edgeGlow: 0.6` |
| `sweep`    | `pattern: 'linear'`, `angle: -20`, `softness: 0.25`   |
| `vortex`   | `pattern: 'spiral'`, `scale: 2`, `softness: 0.2`      |

Apply one with `crossfade({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-depth` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 8.5 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/crossfade`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Luma-keyed wipe with a soft threshold edge, as in classic video switchers; patterns from simple distance functions and fbm noise.
